title: Touchstone test manifest
description: One conformance test: metadata plus an HTTP step sequence with declarative assertions. FROZEN v1 on 2026-07-16 (Gate 2, DECISIONS.md D-0013); any change requires a version bump and a decision entry. 1-1-0 (2026-09-02, D-0045) adds the link:<rel> bind extractor; schemaVersion stays 1, so every 1-0-0 manifest validates unchanged.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema major version; changes only through a reviewed schema revision.

id.description: module/slug, e.g. core/container-containment-after-post; the module segment matches the manifests/ directory.

requirements.description: Catalog requirement IRIs this test verifies (coverage matrix input).

capabilities.description: Server capability keys required to run this test; empty = always runs.

as.description: Default identity for all steps; individual steps may override. When absent, the target's defaultIdentity property applies, and anonymous when it sets none (D-0028).

identity.description: Abstract credential reference resolved by the auth module: alice, bob, anonymous, alice-expired-token, ...

template.description: String with ${...} placeholders. Variables: ${run.root} (per-run root container), ${test.container} (fresh container allocated per test), ${target.baseUrl} (the storage URI the target is registered as), plus names bound by earlier steps' bind blocks.

rawRequest.description: Verbatim HTTP/1.1 message text for hostile or malformed cases; sent over a raw socket, bypassing client normalization (DESIGN.md paragraph 4).

bind.description: Bind response parts to variables for later steps: header:<Name>, link:<rel> (the target of a Link relation, RFC 8288, resolved against the request URI), status, body.

headers.description: Header name to value (or list of values for repeated headers). Values are templates.

body.description: Inline request body. Mutually exclusive with bodyRef.

bodyRef.description: Request-body fixture path relative to the manifest file (e.g. bodies/note.json). Mutually exclusive with body.

status.description: Exact status, or the acceptable set when the spec allows alternatives.

headers.description: Assertions keyed by header name. Negative assertions via absent: true.

json.description: JSON-pointer assertions on the response body (the WD's container representations are JSON-first; DECISIONS.md D-0012).

connegEquivalent.description: Executor re-issues this request once per listed media type and asserts the parsed graphs are isomorphic, resolving relative IRIs against the effective request URI (DESIGN.md paragraph 5.2 conneg round-trip).

headerAssertion.description: Shorthand string = exact expected value; object form for presence/absence/regex/substring.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the response body.

equals.description: Deep equality against this value; templates expanded inside strings.

matches.description: Regex over the string value at the pointer.

exists.description: Assert the pointer resolves (true) or does not (false).

count.description: Array length or object member count at the pointer.

parseAs.description: Override media type when parsing the body as RDF; default is the response Content-Type.

contains.description: Every listed triple must be entailed by the response graph.

notContains.description: Negative assertion: none of these triples may appear.

isomorphicTo.description: Fixture graph file relative to the manifest; blank-node-safe isomorphism (Jena IsoMatcher).

shacl.description: SHACL shapes file relative to the manifest; the response graph must conform.

s.description: Subject IRI after template expansion; the token "_:any" matches any blank node.

o.description: Object: IRI/"_:any" as a string, or a literal object with optional lang/datatype.

equalsRef.description: Byte-exact match against a fixture file relative to the manifest.
